stemMd: Students who use a tutoring service often have lower initial test scores than students who do not. Someone concludes that tutoring lowers scores. Which explanation most directly challenges the conclusion?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Some sessions occur in the afternoon.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The tutoring office has several rooms.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Students seek tutoring because their initial scores are low.

explanationMd: The scores are initial and may motivate students to seek help. This reverses the proposed causal direction and shows why group differences before tutoring cannot demonstrate harm from tutoring.

distractorRationale.d: Writing tools do not explain the initial score difference.
distractorRationale.a: Time of day alone does not establish the cause.
distractorRationale.c: Room count does not address causal direction.
